A.3. BOOKS TRANSLATED BY NINA VAN GORKOM A.3 Books translated by Nina van Gorkom • A Survey of Paramattha Dhammas by Sujin Boriharnwanaket. A Survey of Paramattha Dhammas is a guide to the development of the Buddha’s path of wisdom, covering all aspects of human life and human behaviour, good and bad. This study explains that right understanding is indispensable for mental development, the development of calm as well as the development of insight. • The Perfections Leading to Enlightenment by Sujin Boriharnwanaket. The Perfections is a study of the ten good qualities: generosity, morality, renunciation, wisdom, energy, patience, truthfulness, determination, loving-kindness, and equanimity.
